importance: Supreme festival celebrating Lord Shiva and Sri Chakra manifestation at Srisailam.
description: All godly beings meet at Srisailam; celebrated with grand Utsavas, Lakshadeepotsavas, Pallakisevas, and conclusion by washing tridents in Mallika Gundam.
Includes special Abhishekams, processions, and formal immersion of divine tridents in Mallika Gundam.

importance: Harvest and holy water ritual festival.
description: Rituals completed after washing tridents in the sacred Mallika Gundam water body.

importance: Celebration of victory over Ravana and evil powers by worshipping Aparajita Devi.
description: Worship of Sami (Jammi) Vruksham, vehicle pujas, and exchanging Shami leaves with elders for blessings.

importance: Celebration of the celestial wedding of Sri Mallikarjuna Swamy and Sri Bhramaramba Devi.
description: Includes Nitya Kalyanam to Somaskandamurthi and placing peacock feathers behind Bhramarambika Devi.
Special Abhishekam and Ganapathi Homam performed for trouble removal.

month: Chaitra Bahula Thrayodashi to Vaishaka Shuddhi Saptami
description: Includes Radhotsavam, Kalyanotsavam, and special festivities for Vaidyanatha and Chennakeshava Swamy.
